lines.text: Ava found water, but only a thin trickle over the rocks.
She knelt with her filter straw and got a mouthful of air and grit.
A straw only works where the water is deep enough to reach.
Here's the fix. Carry a bottle.
Fill it where the water runs clearest.
Empty, the bottle folds flat into your pocket.
Ava drank sitting on a rock.
Save this before your next hike.
